description: This file defines an interface 'MaterialsProviderInterface' within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically related to cryptographic materials for AWS encryption SDK. It declares methods for key size support, initialization, encryption key decryption, encryption algorithm retrieval, and IV generation.

classes.name: MaterialsProviderInterface
classes.description: An interface defining cryptographic material provider methods for AWS SDK encryption operations.

methods.name: isSupportedKeySize
methods.description: Checks if the requested key size (in bits) is supported by AES.

methods.name: fromDecryptionEnvelope
methods.description: Performs additional initialization of the materials provider based on metadata inside a MetadataEnvelope.

methods.name: getWrapAlgorithmName
methods.description: Returns the name of the key wrap algorithm used by this provider.

methods.name: decryptCek
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted Content Encryption Key (CEK) using the provider-specific algorithm.

methods.name: generateCek
methods.description: Generates a new content encryption key (CEK) of specified size.

methods.name: generateIv
methods.description: Generates an initialization vector (IV) using the specified OpenSSL cipher name.
